whyUs.title: Why Choose Violette Train
whyUs.uniqueDesc: Our carriages feature premium interiors with designs inspired by H'Mong brocade and Dong Ho paintings, celebrating Vietnamese cultural heritage. Our state-of-the-art VIP lounge system offers a truly comfortable experience.
whyUs.serviceDesc: Our dedicated team is committed to delivering exceptional customer service 24/7, year-round — including public holidays. We pride ourselves on fast, convenient, and reliable solutions.
whyUs.sustainDesc: We are committed to protecting the environment with eco-friendly products. Additionally, we actively support local communities by preserving cultural heritage and enhancing their craftsmanship.

notice.title: Notice Regarding Noise on Vietnam's Railway
notice.text: With over 119 years of history, Vietnam's railway system carries the charm of the past — including the distinctive clatter of the tracks, a nostalgic sound inseparable from the classic train experience. At Violette, we understand noise can affect rest. We've made every effort to minimize it by improving rail joints, upgrading carriages, and installing soundproof materials.

cabins.title: Room Classes
cabins.subtitle: Explore the room classes of Violette Train — each designed for a unique experience.

standard.name: Standard
standard.desc: Shared 4-bed dormitory room, upper bunk cannot be pushed up. Ideal for groups or families seeking a quality train experience at great value. Booking all 4 tickets for a room grants full privacy of the entire space.
standard.config4: 4 guests/room — Experience complete privacy at the best value price.
standard.config2: 2 guests/room — More comfort with only one travel companion.

premium.name: Premium
premium.desc: VIP room with push-up bunk beds (creating luxurious bus-style seating when desired), private lockable door, and en-suite restroom. Available in 2 or 4 guest configurations.
premium.config4: 4 guests/room — Spacious room for families or friend groups at a great rate.
premium.config2: 2 guests/room (VIP) — Beds push up for luxurious seating, complete privacy.
